blocks.text: 英伟达季度业绩超出预期

inlines.text: 英伟达季度业绩超出预期

blocks.text: 季度营收一年内翻倍以上，从 570 亿美元增至 1158 亿美元，增长 103%，其中 AI 数据中心贡献了总营收的 93%。
数据中心营收一年内增长 110%，从 512 亿美元增至 1076 亿美元，英伟达开始向 CoreWeave、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azure 和 Oracle 出货其 Vera Rubin NVL72 机架。
对 AI 云、工业和企业客户的销售额几乎增长两倍，增长 195% 至 475 亿美元，增速几乎是超大规模云巨头的三倍，后者增长 71% 至 601 亿美元。
季度利润翻倍以上，从 319 亿美元增至 653 亿美元，现已超过其一年前 570 亿美元的整个季度营收。
第四季度 1300 亿美元的业绩指引假设对中国没有任何数据中心算力销售，尽管第三季度有 24 亿美元的 Hopper 芯片出货到中国。
quarterly revenue more than doubled in a year, from $57.0B to $115.8B, up 103%, with AI data centers supplying 93% of the total.
Data center revenue rose 110% in a year, from $51.2B to $107.6B, as Nvidia began shipping its Vera Rubin NVL72 racks to CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle.
Sales to AI clouds, industrial and enterprise customers nearly tripled, up 195% to $47.5B, growing almost 3 times faster than the hyperscale cloud giants, which rose 71% to $60.1B.
quarterly profit more than doubled, from $31.9B to $65.3B, which now exceeds its entire quarterly revenue of $57.0B a year earlier.
The $130B fourth-quarter forecast assumes no Chinese data center compute sales, even though $2.4B of Hopper chips shipped there in the third quarter.
